verdict.rationale: Goodwin's technology industry page explicitly claims support across the full corporate lifecycle including venture capital, IPOs, and M&A, and its IPO Readiness resource is directly documented; the Liquidation Calculator also addresses exit-scenario proceeds. However, there is no dedicated M&A practice page or content detailing exit/M&A experience for venture-backed companies specifically — coverage is thinner and more general than the IPO side. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A practice page with venture-backed company deal experience, case studies or league-table evidence of completed exits/IPOs.
